dedupe_keys.name: era5 derived time series of european aggregated surface weather variables wind power and solar power capacity factors hourly data from 1950 2020

description: This University of Reading dataset converts ERA5 weather into hourly variables for European energy-system studies over 1950–2020. It includes surface meteorological series, heating and cooling degree-days, and wind and solar generation capacity factors. Values are aggregated to countries and to selected smaller regions around the United Kingdom and its surrounding seas. Generation weights represent wind and solar farms operating in April 2021; weather aggregates use population weights from 2020. The repository supplies one ZIP archive and a separate README through its open landing page. The internal file encoding was not inspected. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 and access is free. Its fixed weighting scheme is useful for isolating weather variability, but it does not reconstruct the historical evolution of generating assets or population. The series could support generation expansion, heat-demand scenarios and multi-year adequacy simulations. They provide a processed alternative to data-era5-reanalysis and a geographic aggregation distinct from data-era5-cutouts-pypsa-eur-1980-2020; those products should not be treated as identical.
